name: shotdrop-server
description: shotdrop server: stores screenshots in your R2 bucket and serves short links that expire.

SHOTS.description: Private R2 bucket where screenshots are stored. It is **never** made public: the Worker serves each file.

UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: A long random string, for example the output of `openssl rand -hex 24`. Paste the same value in the extension's **Settings**. It can only upload and delete.

TTL_DAYS.description: Days a screenshot lives before it is deleted. Default `7`.
